writeup: Woot has the new Sunnydaze Grecian garden bird bath in Patina Green (model FWD-0041, UPC 810164262004) for $79.99. It is a glass-fiber reinforced concrete bath with a 16-inch shallow bowl and a 20.25-inch height, and it weighs only 14.2 pounds. Sunnydaze Decor's own store lists the matching Patina Green FWD-0041 variant at $165 and shows it in stock. Fountains USA has the same 16-inch bowl, 20.25-inch height Patina Green model at $175, also in stock. That is 51 percent below the lowest verified store price and saves about $85. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
